summary: Exercise native evidence verification owners with bounded binding and receipt properties
details: Add ten synthetic/public native properties covering paged audit chains, evidence lifecycle origins, artifact metadata, backup checks, signed checkpoints, DSSE/Cosign object binding, retention observations and closed subject dispatch.
Exercise actual native commands, authorization policies, canonical hashing and cryptographic adapters, with bounded snapshot ports and atomic receipt/audit capture.
Register all 35 targets and document the concrete parser/verifier owner census separately from lower-level signature and proof algorithms.

compatibility.notes: Tests and development documentation only; existing runtime acceptance, canonical hashes, signing formats and verification taxonomy remain unchanged.

security: Preserve tenant ownership, immutable source snapshots, append-only receipt binding and limited verdicts for metadata-only profiles. Synthetic observations establish no external provider proof.
limitations: Finite campaigns supplement deterministic regressions and do not establish exhaustive coverage or cryptographic assurance.
Transaction port models do not replace live persistence gates; recorded backup checks do not prove restoration, and synthetic retention observations do not prove WORM enforcement.
